scope: Small Range requests only; no full-layer download, system configuration change, active Docker build change, or persistence of tokens/signed URLs.
assessment: All Range probes succeeded with HTTP 206 and matching Content-Range. Four Docker proxy connections provided only about 1.15x aggregate improvement in this short sample. NGC serves exactly the same amd64 manifest, but its measured single-connection rates were lower than Docker proxy in this sample. These short samples do not establish a durable bandwidth cap or justify a custom OCI multi-range downloader as a significant speedup.
network_caveat: Earlier direct probes only disabled the explicit HTTP proxy; system Mihomo TUN may still intercept that traffic. Physical-interface probes additionally bind wlx6c1ff780c0b6 and resolve official CDN names to real public DNS IPv4 addresses.
